fixtures.note: Code P: the CEO, who is also a director, buys 2,500 shares on the open market in two lines. Both role boxes checked on one owner.
Code S: a director sells, no plan, no footnotes on the trade. Also a nonDerivativeHolding line (shares held by a trust), which is not a transaction and takes no line number.
Code A: a director's stock award, filed with a price of 0. The price must come out null, not zero.
Code M: RSUs vest (derivative M, disposed) into common stock (non-derivative M, acquired), and code F withholds shares for tax. The shape most Form 4 lines have, and none of it is a signal.
A 10b5-1 plan sale: checkbox ticked and the sale's own footnote names the plan. The PSU exercise beside it cites no plan footnote and must not be flagged.
A 10b5-1 checkbox with no footnote naming the plan, so both sales are flagged. Weighted-average prices with ranges ('at prices from $26.25 to $26.80').
Five reporting owners on one filing: a GP, its manager, a holding company and two people, all 10% owners, reporting four sales once for all of them.
A 4/A correcting the share count of an RSU award: dateOfOriginalSubmission and a remark saying what changed.
